author: BlueSage9
quote: A GTA game without any soul in it. This game feels more like an agenda than an actual game with solid story. Agenda is to force down the woman empowerment where she can do whatever she wants and it’s never wrong. Lucia is terrible as a partner who has made dumb choices which are somehow validated. Jason has no soul or character. He is more like an NPC than the main character. All he does is agree with Lucia even tho she did terrible things for the relationship and ghosted him and all of a sudden, she is expecting Jason to be there when she gets out. She can cheat in him and he doesn’t care. She can tell him to jump off of a roof and he will do that. The list can go on and on. A lot of stuff is said to be optional but it really isn’t. Having a good relationship with Lucia is crucial to unlock missions that are crucial to the story. Overall a terrible story that looks good and runs at 30 fps. Terrible writing and game direction. I hope Rockstar never recovers from this.
